Once you exit the game, your save file will be synchronized with the Steam Cloud. 
You can then [b]play the game on any different device and quickly resume where you left off![/b]

notes.title: Have You Played Heart s Medicine Time to Heal?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day, perhaps for all time.

Romance! Drama! Surgery! Ambulance crashes! Heart’s Medicine – Time to Heal is a time management game by way of medical soap operas, like Gray’s Anatomy or Casualty, and I kind of love it.
